# Leaflet 1.9.4

`leaflet.js`, `leaflet.css` and `LICENSE` from the npm package
`leaflet@1.9.4` (`dist/` and the package root), BSD 2-Clause licence (see
`LICENSE`). Package tarball SHA-256
`84c65a256e50657896f54c33bd857b6849ebe94c817803be818bf32a3dde0b77`; npm
integrity `sha512-nxS1ynzJOmOlHp+iL3FyWqK89GtNL8U8rvlMOsQdTTssxZwCXh8N2NB3GDQOL+YR3XnWyZAxwQixURb+FA74PA==`.

`leaflet.css` and `LICENSE` ship with Windows line endings; they were
converted to Unix line endings so they can be built into the binary byte for
byte. No other changes.
